title: 片手で扉を開く
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE original square pose preview for an art studio website. Create one finished detailed gouache/anime illustration of ONE clothed young adult with medium tousled brown hair, natural facial features, cream long sleeve shirt with rolled cuffs, loose indigo trousers, pale sneakers. Plain pale ivory studio backdrop with soft warm natural shading. Natural face, fingers, joints, dimensional clothing folds, broad gender neutral styling. Whole body including both feet completely visible, character and necessary prop large about 80%canvas, clear action readable as small UI thumbnail. Single distinct image, NOT stick figure, NOT schematic, NOT flat icon, NOT contact sheet. No text, labels, diagram arrows, logos, grid, border, fancy costumes, brands or watermark. Action: Opening ONE wooden door with one hand and stepping into the opening. Three-quarter side view. Fingers clasp its door handle at waist/chest height, arm visibly continuous from shoulder to handle. Door visibly pivots on hinges within simple frame, enough opening for person to pass. Free arm relaxed and both feet on same floor. Minimal door support rather than elaborate background.

visualQA.reviewer: Codex visual inspection of generated image
visualQA.observations: 片手が扉の取っ手に接し、開いた一枚の扉と通路、自然に踏み出す足と自由な腕が読める。
